route_note: Take a direct bus from Budva bus station to Kotor bus station, about 1 hour, with frequent departures; the old town is a short walk from the bus station.
Take a bus from Budva to Kotor bus station, then a local bus or taxi along the bay to Perast, about 30 minutes; allow extra time for return connections.
see: Church of Our Lady of the Rocks
tour_query: Perast and Kotor day trip from Budva

route_note: Take a direct bus from Budva to Cetinje bus station, about 1 hour via the mountain road; buses run regularly and the centre is walkable from the station.
Take a bus from Budva to Bar bus station, about 30 minutes, then a local bus or taxi about 10 to 15 minutes up to the Stari Bar ruins.
tour_query: Stari Bar day trip from Budva

route_note: Take a direct bus from Budva bus station to Ulcinj bus station, about 1 hour 20 minutes along the coast; the old town is a short walk or taxi ride from the station.
